seed_rule: enumerate every defined-j point of absolute Frobenius trace 64, then evaluate rational degree-2/3 Hecke rows once per seed point
frontier_rule: evaluate all five torsion translates of each distinct trace-64 seed orbit once for degrees 2 and 3; add verified rational neighbors as stage-0 columns
acceptance: all l+1 neighbors rational with defined j, verified modular polynomial and group sum
target_law: SHA-256 seed interpreted as a positive integer modulo 4021, multiplied by G=5(1,8630) to construct the public target point outside the online interval
rebuild_validation: compare regenerated trace-64 source set, seed and first-frontier accepted row multisets, new-column set, and rejection counters to the saved original ledgers
work_record: record exact source, degree-query, accepted-row, and shift-probe counts; local phase wall times are exploratory setup diagnostics only
